findings.title: Repository metadata
evidence: Repository metadata was retrieved.
findings.review_note: Use this metadata as context for other findings.

findings.title: Repository security and analysis settings
evidence: security_and_analysis fields were present in repository metadata.
findings.review_note: Omitted or null fields are recorded as unavailable, not failures.
limitations: Field availability varies by repository visibility, plan, and token permissions.

findings.title: Dependency Graph
evidence: Repository metadata or security configuration reported Dependency Graph enabled.
findings.review_note: Dependency Graph state is separate from Dependabot alert and update settings.

findings.title: Automatic dependency submission
evidence: Automatic dependency submission was not set in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Review whether this repository uses ecosystems that need automatic dependency submission.

findings.title: Code security configuration attachment
evidence: No code security configuration was attached in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Review organization-level security configuration separately if the owner is an organization.

findings.title: Security policy presence
evidence: The sample community profile did not include a security policy file.
findings.review_note: For public projects, consider documenting how to report vulnerabilities.

findings.title: GitHub Actions repository permissions
evidence: Actions permissions were retrievable.
The sample observation allowed all actions and did not require SHA pinning.
findings.review_note: Review allowed actions and SHA pinning requirements against repository policy.

findings.title: Selected Actions allowlist
findings.review_note: Collect selected action details when repository Actions policy is selected.

findings.title: GITHUB_TOKEN default workflow permissions
evidence: Default workflow permission was read in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Workflow-level permissions blocks are not inspected by v0.1.

findings.title: Private repository Actions component access

observed.reason: endpoint applies only to internal and private repositories

evidence: The sample repository was public, so private repository component access was not applicable.
findings.review_note: Run this check for private or internal repositories that share actions or reusable workflows.

findings.title: Branch rulesets inventory
evidence: The sample observation returned zero branch-targeting rulesets.
findings.review_note: Ruleset count alone is not a default-branch protection verdict.

findings.title: Active rules for default branch
evidence: No active rules were returned for the default branch in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Review legacy branch protection and repository policy before making a protection verdict.

findings.title: Default branch summary
evidence: Default branch summary was retrieved.
findings.review_note: The branch summary is not a detailed branch protection policy.

findings.title: Legacy branch protection for default branch
evidence: Detailed legacy branch protection was not returned in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: A 404 may mean absent protection or unavailable evidence; combine with active rules and branch summary.
limitations: No policy verdict is made from this response alone.

findings.title: CodeQL default setup
evidence: CodeQL default setup was not configured in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: This does not prove advanced setup or third-party SARIF is absent.

findings.title: Dependabot version updates configuration
evidence: No Dependabot version-update configuration file was found in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Dependabot security updates can still work without version updates.

findings.title: Dependabot security updates
evidence: Automated security fixes were enabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Review Dependabot workflow compatibility separately.

findings.title: Dependabot vulnerability alerts
evidence: The sample observation received the enabled 204 status.
findings.review_note: Alert listing is reported separately from the setting.

findings.title: Private vulnerability reporting
evidence: Private vulnerability reporting was not enabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Review whether public security reports should be accepted privately for this repository.

findings.title: CODEOWNERS syntax errors
evidence: CODEOWNERS syntax errors were not returned in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: A missing CODEOWNERS file is not the same as zero syntax errors.

findings.title: Secret scanning
evidence: Repository metadata reported secret scanning enabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Do not expose secret values in audit output.

findings.title: Secret scanning push protection
evidence: Repository metadata reported secret scanning push protection enabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Keep push protection inventory separate from open alert counts.

findings.title: Deployment environments
evidence: No deployment environments were returned in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Missing environments may be normal for repositories without deployments.

findings.title: Repository Actions secrets metadata
evidence: Repository Actions secrets metadata was retrievable.
findings.review_note: Only names and metadata are inventory; values are never available or reported.

findings.title: Organization Actions secrets visible to repository
findings.review_note: This endpoint applies when organization secrets are visible to the repository.
limitations: The sample owner context did not provide organization secret inventory.

findings.title: Environment secrets metadata
findings.review_note: No environment secret inventory was collected because no environments were returned.

findings.title: OIDC subject claim customization
evidence: GitHub-side OIDC subject customization was retrievable.
findings.review_note: Cloud provider trust policy is outside the GitHub API evidence collected by v0.1.
limitations: No cloud IAM trust policy was inspected.

findings.title: Repository self-hosted runners
evidence: No repository self-hosted runners were returned in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Organization or enterprise runner exposure may require a separate owner-level audit.

findings.title: Immutable releases
evidence: Immutable releases were reported as disabled in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Review only if this repository publishes releases or release assets.
limitations: A release process was not inspected.

findings.title: Releases inventory
evidence: No releases were returned in the sample observation.
findings.review_note: Release inventory is contextual for immutable releases and artifact attestations.

findings.title: Open Dependabot alerts
evidence: The fully paginated sample observation returned zero open Dependabot alerts.
findings.review_note: Zero open alerts is endpoint evidence, not proof that no vulnerable dependency exists.

findings.title: Open secret scanning alerts
evidence: The fully paginated sample observation returned zero open secret scanning alerts.
findings.review_note: Do not include secret values, paths, or line numbers in v0.1 output.

findings.title: Open code scanning alerts
findings.review_note: Enable or grant access to code scanning results, then re-run the audit.
limitations: Code scanning alerts were unavailable in the sample observation.

findings.title: Artifact attestations
findings.review_note: Provide release artifact digests to query attestations; cryptographic verification remains separate.
limitations: The repository API does not provide a repo-wide attestation coverage verdict.

findings.title: SBOM inventory
findings.review_note: SBOM generation/fetch is not part of the default read-only v0.1 recipe.
limitations: GitHub provides Dependency Graph SBOM APIs, but v0.1 does not collect or interpret SBOM content by default.

findings.title: Dependency review

source.name: dependency review API or workflow inspection

findings.review_note: Dependency review requires a comparison or workflow/action inspection, which v0.1 does not run by default.

findings.title: Workflow file security diagnostics
findings.review_note: Workflow-level permissions, pinned action refs, untrusted input handling, zizmor, and Scorecard are outside v0.1.

findings.title: Repository access surface

source.name: collaborators, teams, deploy keys, webhooks, variables, and broader secrets inventory

findings.review_note: Access review can expose sensitive operational metadata and is not collected by default v0.1.

limitations: This is a sample output contract, not a current audit result.
Open alert counts depend on endpoint availability, feature state, token permissions, and pagination.
No workflow files, local repository contents, cloud provider trust policies, or remediation actions were inspected.
No secret values are collected or reported.
